name: Capes to Calobra: The Mallorca Explorer Ride
summary: Three riding days from Port de Pollença: Sa Calobra, Lluc, the Orient valley and Cap de Formentor. The "less easy" group, hire bikes on the island, e-bikes welcome.
bikeOptionsText:
Hire a carbon road bike (about €100–180) | hire
